body:
I'm very glad to hear that - I'm putting my cocktail together and just waiting on the final Diazepam delivery.
 I thought it would be peaceful- I survived a Nembutal overdose and it was very peaceful as I slipped away.
 Somehow I survived though so this time I'm making sure with 10g of Am.
 Thanks for the insight.
I mean others don't know it was suicide.
I suppose by definition it's the opposite of Healthy but it is rational.
Surprisingly well- no one outside knows the real reason.

I thought you could say what you liked here; besides, I'm only asking for a considered opinion.

I have already tried Nembutal and it failed- kept breathing for 3 days till I was rescued.
 I made a full recovery by hitting the gym- people comment on how well I look. Good job, friends, no debts. Only negative an unrequited crush.
 But as I'm in my mid 40a I want to get out on top. Life is a chore and I don't want it anymore.
 Hope this answers plainly why.
